title: Catalog-HBI CROSS-MOCK TRANSFER legs -- frozen 2LPT-0 recipe, no refit, sub-DLA report limits (19.5, 20.0, 20.3). ALL MOCK, public-OK.

metadata.rederive: export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 HDF5_USE_FILE_LOCKING=FALSE; /home/mfho/.conda/envs/gpdla/bin/python CDDF_analysis/hbi/build_crossmock_transfer_artifact.py --legs-root <scratch>/crossmock_legs --fp-estimator both --out CDDF_analysis/hbi/crossmock_transfer_artifact.json  # runs all 8 legs (4 mocks x 2 FP estimators) via the committed track_c_tf_{2lpt1,london0,saclay}.py drivers; ~10 min on a login node. MUST be run from a CLEAN tree (no modified tracked files) or the stamp is suffixed -dirty and the provenance guard will refuse it.

estimand.point: PLUG-IN MAP of the catalog-HBI v3 estimator with the MEASURED FORWARD-RESPONSE kernel (resp_kind='forward'). NOT a posterior median.
estimand.interval: NONE. --point-only: no MC band was drawn. Do not attach an uncertainty to these numbers and do not table them beside a posterior-median number without labelling both.
estimand.status: DIAGNOSTIC-grade under the PI's 2026-07 band decision (paper-facing bands must be credible intervals from faithful joint posterior sampling, point = median of the SAME posterior). A plug-in MAP is explicitly a diagnostic.
estimand.cumulative_vs_band: cumulative_R0[lim] is R0 for the CUMULATIVE quantity >= lim; subdla_band_19p5_20p3 is the DIFFERENTIAL [19.5, 20.3) band formed by differencing two cumulatives. DIFFERENT ESTIMANDS.
estimand.calibration: FROZEN 2LPT-0: forward_response_2lpt0.npz + g(N,z) + the lya_only-nhi195 molly C/rho matrix. NO refit on any held-out mock. Only the held-out-side FP model changes between the two fp_estimator families.

quotability.dndx: QUOTABLE. truth_reductions' dN/dX carries its own z-mask (t_zidx >= 0), so it is not B16-contaminated.
quotability.omega: NOT QUOTABLE at this commit. Omega is built from f_truth, which at the stamped commit counts truth rows with NO z-mask against a z-MASKED Delta-X (B16). RE-DERIVE after the B16 fix lands; never rescale by a scalar.
quotability.f_of_N: not emitted by this artifact (point-only, integrated reductions).

metadata.mock: 2lpt0 / 2lpt1 / london0 / saclay0 are ALL MOCK (public-OK). The loa-0 FP product is the HCD-free TWIN MOCK, not real LoA. No real-DESI (loa main-dark) data was read by any leg. Provenance test: mock TARGETID is O(1e3-1e8), real DESI is O(1e16).

inputs.role: loa-0 twin-mock FP product (loa0 estimator only)
London-0 staged mockdir (truth dla_cat.fits + zcat + staged snr_cat)
Saclay-0 native mockdir (truth hcd_truth_cat.fits + native snr_cat)

supersedes.why: both were UNTRACKED, every per-leg stamp read '<sha>-dirty', and their own provenance_note recorded that the FINAL AGGREGATION WAS MANUAL with no committed aggregator ('build_artifact_loa0.py was never written'). This artifact replaces them: committed routine, 40-char stamp captured at process start, git-tracked output.

metadata.provenance_note: Legs re-run from a CLEAN checkout of the stamped commit via the committed drivers; the aggregation step is now itself a committed routine (metadata.routine). Numbers WILL differ from the retired untracked JSONs wherever the committed code has moved since d496f42 -- that difference is the point of re-deriving, not an error.

config.variant_policy: floor leg: A only (the point is variant-independent under --point-only); transfer legs: both A and B, with the A-vs-B agreement recorded per leg.

2lpt0_self.note: ON-MOCK CALIBRATION / RECOVERY FLOOR -- held-out == the calibration mock itself, scored through the SAME forward-path driver. NOT a transfer. Subtract it to isolate the cross-recipe part of every other leg.
2lpt0_self.recipe: LyaCoLoRe-2LPT v2.8.5 mock-0 / loa-124 (the calibration mock)

2lpt1.note: SAME RECIPE as the calibration mock, DIFFERENT REALIZATION (mock-1). A realization check, NOT a recipe transfer. It also has NO spectra-16 and NO processed GP .h5 anywhere on GreatLakes -- see metadata.mock_roles -- so it runs off the PACKAGED catalog only and cannot be re-processed or re-flagged.

london0.note: GENUINE TRANSFER -- LyaCoLoRe on a CoLoRe lognormal density field.

saclay.note: GENUINE TRANSFER -- Saclay Gaussian density field + FGPA, deeper Lyman series (quickquasars --metals LYB..LY8 vs LYB..LY5 for 2LPT).
